criteria.description: Leads with Ready with conditions for the internal pilot, with analytics as the explicit condition before general availability.
Covers filtered export, admin-only access, empty/escaping behaviour, analytics and the internal-only rollout boundary.
Marks export and authorisation Pass, analytics Fail, and cites the strongest evidence for each.
Does not block the internal pilot for the bounded analytics gap and does not incorrectly call the feature fully Ready to ship for general availability.
Names the analytics event, owner and GA boundary as the concrete condition.
Keeps the review concise and decision-oriented.
